teaching.description: Twaravye amajambo arangiza icete ca mbere ca Petero avuga kuvy'umubabaro n'ukuza kwa kabiri kwa Kristo . Twabonye ko umubabaro uzana igikorwa c'ivyizigiro . Umubabaro uzana ukwicisha bugufi n'ukwihangana.
